prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R59 is not modeled: the Delete/Change Job flow does not require User Id and Password as an authentication condition.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R59 states that 'User Id and Password are required to ensure that only the appropriate user is able to delete or change the job.' The current delete/change branch has no login or authorization check before allowing delete or change actions.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add an authentication step before the delete/change decision and only allow the branch to proceed when the user is verified.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R50 is not modeled: the View Job Status flow does not require User Id and Password as an authentication condition.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R50 states that 'User Id and Password are required to ensure that only the appropriate user is able to see the job status.' The current View Job Status branch starts at N9 and proceeds directly to showing options, with no authentication step or guard.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Insert an authentication check before showing job status options, and gate the View Job Status branch on successful User Id/Password validation.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R88 is not represented: the diagram does not model cluster-status update when a job ends and is removed from the cluster.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R88 requires that Libra updates the cluster status 'when a job ends and is removed from the cluster.' The only cluster-status update shown is N36 during job scheduling; there is no end-of-job/removal trigger or corresponding update path.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add a termination/completion path from job execution to a cluster-status update action that is triggered when the job finishes and is removed.

prioritized_defects.description: The submission gate at N7 conflates separate requirements and introduces 'submission allowed' as a single decision without separately modeling cluster openness, user validity, and the distinct submit-job interface adaptation path.
prioritized_defects.evidence: The requirements distinguish cluster-open validation (R43/R44) from the Accept/Reject Job function (R46), and also require SGE interface adaptation or alternate command-line submission support (R36/R37). N7 combines these into one decision labeled 'Submission allowed and user valid?' and does not represent the interface-adaptation aspect.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Split submission handling into explicit cluster-open and user-validity checks, and represent the SGE interface adaptation or CLI alternative separately if it is part of the modeled scope.

prioritized_defects.description: The stride-scheduling loop is modeled without an explicit termination check tied to 'no jobs left to run on a queue', so the repeat-until condition is not semantically clear.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R99 says the loop is repeated until there are no jobs left to run on a queue. N37 is labeled as a loop, but the body nodes N38-N40 do not explicitly show the exit condition being tested after advancing pass, nor the 'no jobs left' termination criterion.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Make the loop condition explicit as a repeat-until or while construct that exits when the queue is empty.
